issues.body:
Track the user-requested API, library and MCP integrations, building on Noesis's existing capabilities.

Scope approved on 2026-09-05: remove Notion MCP; replace US-focused data-source suggestions with EU/German/Berlin sources; keep globally useful infrastructure and scope provider examples to this region.

Regional replacements:
- ClinicalTrials.gov → CTIS (EU/EEA) and DRKS (Germany).
- CourtListener → EUR-Lex/CELLAR, German federal decisions, and Berlin laws/decisions.
- openFDA → EMA public medicine information and BfArM safety letters.
- Notion MCP is excluded. This roadmap does not remove existing US connectors from the codebase.
- OpenCorporates, OpenSanctions and Wikidata remain global providers with EU/German/Berlin acquisition and test scope. GitHub, search vendors and general libraries are not US-only datasets.

## New granular work items

New provider/connection means a dedicated integration was not found during the review; reuse generic REST/MCP federation, identity, acquisition, budgets, reviews and provenance infrastructure. issues.body:
This issue tracks the scope below. Implement the linked sub-issues individually; close this parent when all required tasks are complete. Evaluation tasks close on a documented adopt/defer decision.

Implementation tasks:

- [ ] #1390 — Add pagination and date windows to the existing Guardian API client
- [ ] #1391 — Expose Guardian API collection through domain source packs
- [ ] #1392 — Deduplicate Guardian API, RSS and HTML representations by article identity

Original scope and evidence:

Priority: medium

The legacy NewsAggregatorConnector already calls https://content.guardianapis.com/search and requests article body fields. It should be reused rather than described as a new API integration. Its visible fetch implementation handles one result page and does not apply the supplied date window. The domain ingestion paths currently include Guardian RSS and a brittle HTML spider.

Expose this existing provider through the bounded domain acquisition/runtime surface, with appropriate normalization and capability readiness.

Acceptance:
- Reuse the legacy provider logic through a maintained adapter instead of duplicating a second Guardian client.
- Support bounded pagination, section/query/date filters and checkpointed incremental collection.
- Normalize body HTML with preserved original content, provider article IDs, canonical URLs, publication/update times and contributor metadata.
- Respect configured credentials, quotas and content permissions; distinguish developer/non-commercial access from commercial access.
- Make API/RSS/HTML source selection explicit and deduplicate representations without counting them as independent reporting origins.
- Use native recorded responses and an opt-in live check; report coverage and failures honestly.
- Audit existing NewsAPI/other aggregator implementations for reusable pieces, with truncated content labeled as such.

Code: src/scraper/extensions/connectors/news_aggregator_connector.py:199, src/ingestion/scrapy_integration.py, src/scraper/spiders/guardian_spider.py
